Definition: from a derivative of G4238; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector:--officer.
BiblicalUsage: Praktor is the officer, the collector, the one who enforces the debt. Jesus warns to agree with your adversary quickly, lest he deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into prison.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that debts unpaid grow into prisons, and agreement on the way is always cheaper than judgment at the end.
